versions.changelog:
Initial release of life-money-skill

- Provides a structured workflow for career monetization diagnosis and side income planning.
- Implements a 4-stage pipeline with 3 mandatory checkpoints based on user input and material verification.
- Generates a single-file HTML report after seven rounds of analysis.
- Ensures modular loading of guides/specs and strict adherence to outlined methodology rules.
- Introduces schema validation and QA procedures for all outputs.
